_comment: Anchor registry for the cost layer (scripts/cost_ledger.py, scripts/cost_cfo.py),
Every anchor is a low-high range with its unit, source, as-of month (source_date),
confidence (published, or assumption: Hawthorn's choice, with its basis stated) and
the date by which it must be re-checked against the publisher's current edition
(reverify_by). A published anchor needs a source_url. An id ending in _solar, _wind
or _battery_storage applies to that technology only and carries the matching
technology field; an id without one applies to every technology that has no
specific anchor. Sources were opened and quoted on 2026-11-05.
credit_deadlines are the federal clean electricity credit dates (Public Law 119-21
and IRS Notice 2025-42). They are steps at a date, not rates: the CFO view lists
them and prices the credit at stake at a termination date as capex x credit_rate.
Whether a project qualifies is a question for the project's own tax counsel.

anchors.description: Installed cost of utility-scale PV per MW (AC), projects reaching commercial operation in 2025, 2025 dollars
anchors.source: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 31: 'Capacity-weighted means ... increased from $1.65/WAC in 2024 to $1.69/WAC in 2025. Medians ... increased from $1.74/WAC in 2024 to $1.77/WAC in 2025.' Low is the capacity-weighted mean, high the median. PV only; 2025 figures are preliminary. By size, slide 33 runs from $1.53/WAC (over 250 MW) to $2.10/WAC (under 20 MW).

anchors.description: Installed cost of land-based wind per MW
anchors.source: Low: LBNL Land-Based Wind Market Report 2024 Edition, executive summary p. 8: installed costs 'since 2018, have largely held steady at ~$1,700/MW [per kW] on a capacity-weighted average basis' (2023 dollars; regional averages as low as $1,320/kW in SPP). High: NLR (formerly NREL) 2025 Electricity ATB workbook, land-based wind CAPEX $1,920/kW for 2024 (2023 dollars, Moderate scenario), https://data.openei.org/files/8759/2025_v1_Workbook_08-27-2026.xlsx. The LBNL 2025 and 2026 wind editions could not be opened on 2026-11-05; read the 2026 edition before relying on this range.

anchors.description: Total capital cost of a 4-hour utility-scale battery per MW of power
anchors.source: Lazard LCOE+ (July 2026, LCOS v11.0), 4-hour utility-scale storage: 'Total Capital Cost $/kWh $270 - $365' (including inverter), times 4 hours. NLR 2025 ATB gives $1,449/kW for 2024, inside the range.

anchors.description: Annual change in the installed cost of utility-scale PV, real dollars
anchors.source: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 7: installed costs of new PV were '$1.7/WAC ... 2% higher than in 2024'; the median rose from $1.74 to $1.77/WAC (1.7%, slide 31). A change in real dollars: nominal escalation is higher by the rate of inflation.

anchors.description: Annual change in the installed cost of land-based wind, real dollars
anchors.source: Assumption. LBNL Land-Based Wind Market Report 2024 Edition, p. 8, says installed cost has 'largely held steady' since 2018 (low end 0); the high end is the solar figure, since no wind source gives one.

anchors.description: Annual change in the installed cost of utility-scale battery storage, real dollars
anchors.source: Assumption. No source gives a year-over-year change in standalone storage capex. The high end is LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 12: 'Costs of PV+battery projects increased 4% to $2.7/WAC-PV in 2025.'

anchors.description: Net AC capacity factor of utility-scale PV
anchors.source: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition: slide 39, fleet 'cumulative net capacity factor ... is 23% but ranges from 6% to 40%'; slide 8, first-year capacity factor of 2024 plants rose 'from an average of 24% to 25%'.

anchors.description: Net capacity factor of land-based wind
anchors.source: LBNL Land-Based Wind Market Report 2024 Edition, p. 7: 'The average capacity factor in 2023 was 33.5% on a fleet-wide basis and 38.2% among wind plants built in 2022.'

anchors.description: Power purchase agreement price for utility-scale solar
anchors.source: Low: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 10, average levelized PPA price of 2025-COD projects, $34/MWh (25th to 75th percentile $27-47; contracts signed 1.5 to 4 years before operation). High: LevelTen North American PPA Price Index Q3 2026: 'Core-Markets P25 Solar Price ... rests at $64.23/MWh' (offers, not signed contracts), https://www.leveltenenergy.com/post/levelten-north-american-ppa-price-index-q3-2026.

anchors.description: Power purchase agreement price for land-based wind
anchors.source: Low: LBNL Land-Based Wind Market Report 2024 Edition, p. 8, recent levelized PPA prices '~$25/MWh' in the Central and West regions (2021-22 contracts; '~$45/MWh' in the East). High: LevelTen North American PPA Price Index Q3 2026: 'Core-Markets P25 Wind Price for Q3 came in at $68.27/MWh' (offers), https://www.leveltenenergy.com/post/levelten-north-american-ppa-price-index-q3-2026.

anchors.description: Revenue of a 4-hour battery per kW of power per month
anchors.source: Assumption. No published tolling or capacity price was found. Revenue is set equal to Lazard LCOE+ (July 2026) unsubsidized levelized cost of 4-hour storage, $266-369 per kW-year (about $22-31 per kW-month): the revenue at which the project recovers its costs.

anchors.description: Fixed operation and maintenance cost of utility-scale PV
anchors.source: Low: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 36, O&M costs 'about $11/kWAC-year' (FERC Form 1 scope, without property tax, insurance or land). High: NLR 2025 ATB utility-scale PV page, '$24.66/kW AC-yr for 2024', https://atb.nlr.gov/electricity/2025/utility-scale_pv.

anchors.description: Fixed operation and maintenance cost of land-based wind
anchors.source: NLR 2025 Electricity ATB workbook, land-based wind fixed O&M: $43.0/kW-year (2023 base year) and $41.9/kW-year (2024), 2023 dollars, Moderate scenario.

anchors.description: Fixed operation and maintenance cost of a 4-hour battery per kW of power
anchors.source: Lazard LCOE+ (July 2026), 4-hour storage O&M $3.75-7.75 per kWh-year, times 4 hours. Lazard's figures, to match the revenue assumption taken from its levelized cost. NLR 2025 ATB puts fixed O&M at about $50/kW-year, including battery augmentation.

anchors.description: Operating life of a utility-scale PV project
anchors.source: NLR 2025 ATB, financial cases and methods: cost recovery period '30 years for all technologies' (low). LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 45: 'Project design life increases from 21.5 years in 2007 to 35 years in 2021 and thereafter' (high).

anchors.description: Operating life of a land-based wind project
anchors.source: NLR 2025 ATB, land-based wind and financial cases and methods: technical life and cost recovery period of 30 years.

anchors.description: Operating life of a utility-scale battery
anchors.source: NLR 2025 ATB utility-scale battery storage: '15-year lifetime' (low), https://atb.nlr.gov/electricity/2025/utility-scale_battery_storage. Lazard LCOE+ (July 2026): 'Project Life ... 20' years (high).

anchors.description: Cost of capital (nominal), used to discount the deferred net revenue stream
anchors.source: Assumption. Low: NLR 2025 ATB nominal WACC without tax credits, 5.63% for utility PV and 5.74% for land-based wind (Moderate, WACC Calc sheet). High: Hawthorn's allowance for merchant and storage risk; Lazard's storage case assumes 20% debt at 8% and 80% equity at 12%, about 11%.

anchors.description: Development spending before construction (engineering, permits, interconnection studies, land and community outreach) as a share of installed cost
anchors.source: Assumption, taken from NREL/NLR Q1 2024 Solar Cost Benchmarks (PVSCM 2024, file 'UPV 2024Q1.txt'): 'Officework' (engineering, permits, interconnection, land outreach) of $32-69 per kWdc against a total of $1,021-1,212 per kWdc for a 100 MWdc single-axis project, 2.6% to 6.8%. Applied to wind and storage as well; network upgrade deposits are not in it.

anchors.description: Clean electricity investment credit (48E) as a share of qualified investment, prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements met, before bonus adders
anchors.source: 26 U.S.C. 48E(a)(2): the applicable percentage is 6 percent, or 30 percent when the prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements are met. Applied to the full per-MW capital cost, so it is an upper bound where qualified investment is smaller than installed cost; the energy community and domestic content adders are not included.

credit_deadlines.rule: Construction must begin by this date for the 2027 placed-in-service cutoff not to apply (Public Law 119-21 sections 70512 and 70513; IRS Notice 2025-42: the physical work test is the only method, and the 5% safe harbor is kept only for solar of 1.5 MW AC or less).
credit_deadlines.source: IRS Notice 2025-42, p. 2 ('beginning of construction deadline ... July 4, 2026')

credit_deadlines.rule: A wind or solar facility whose construction begins after 2026-07-04 gets no 45Y or 48E credit if placed in service after this date
credit_deadlines.source: Public Law 119-21, section 70512 (45Y(d)(4)) and section 70513 (48E): 'shall not apply with respect to any applicable facility placed in service after December 31, 2027'

credit_deadlines.rule: A facility whose construction began by 2026-07-04 keeps the continuity safe harbor if placed in service no more than four calendar years after the year construction began (end of 2030 for construction begun in 2026)
credit_deadlines.source: IRS Notice 2025-42, p. 11 ('no more than four calendar years after')

credit_deadlines.rule: Energy storage is exempt from the 2027 cutoff; its credit is the full credit for construction beginning by the end of 2033, 75% in 2034, 50% in 2035 and none after (applicable year 2032)
credit_deadlines.source: Public Law 119-21 section 70513 ('shall not apply with respect to any energy storage technology') and 26 U.S.C. 48E(e)(2) phase-out schedule
